# XYZ Lab

> XYZ Lab is a digital marketing tutorial site offering step-by-step video guides, benchmarks, prompt libraries, report templates, and courses on paid advertising, analytics, AI tools, SEO, eCommerce, web builders, and social media platforms.

## Courses

- [Data Studio Full Course](https://xyzlab.com/data-studio/course/): Complete Looker Studio / Data Studio course for marketers.
